text:
BIG-IP LTM v9.0.5
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 9.0.5
CACHE::headers
- Returns the HTTP
headers of the cache response.
CACHE::payload
- Returns the HTTP
payload of the cache response.
HTTP::disable
- Changes the HTTP filter
from full parsing to passthrough mode.
HTTP::enable
- Changes the HTTP filter
from passthrough to full parsing mode.
TCP::bandwidth
- Returns a bandwidth
estimate for the peer.
UDP::respond
- Sends data directly to a
peer.
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 9.0.5
CACHE_RESPONSE
- Triggered immediately
prior to sending a cache response.
